## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines classes to implement an intrusive doubly linked list class (i.e.</p>


<p>each node of the list must contain a next and previous field for the list.</p>


<p>The ilist class itself should be a plug in replacement for list. This list replacement does not provide a constant time <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/nvptx/nvvmreflect-cpp/#ac934769d93af95250952646a3829df4c">size()</a> method, so be careful to use empty() when you really want to know if it's empty.</p>


<p>The ilist class is implemented as a circular list. The list itself contains a sentinel node, whose Next points at begin() and whose Prev points at rbegin(). The sentinel node itself serves as end() and rend().</p>
